## Company

- Name: B-Code (بي‑كود)
- Website: https://b-code.tech
- Focus: Web development, Odoo ERP, custom software
- Languages: English and Arabic
- Contact email: baiomayomar@gmail.com

## Services

- Web development: marketing sites and web apps optimized for speed, conversion, and maintainability
- Odoo development: ERP implementation, customization, integrations, and operational workflows
- Custom software: APIs, dashboards, internal tools, and systems built around client processes

## Who we help

- Companies that need a credible digital presence
- Teams adopting or expanding Odoo ERP
- Organizations that need custom software instead of disconnected tools
- Bilingual (Arabic / English) product and marketing experiences

## How to engage

1. Send a short project brief (website, Odoo, or custom software)
2. B-Code replies with next steps and scope options
3. Discovery → design → build → launch with clear milestones
